As Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Stock Price Rose, Fred Alger Management Has Decreased Its Stake; Gyroscope Capital Management Group Has Increased Position in Apple (AAPL) by $3.32 Million 
April 16, 2018 - By Marguerite Chambers 
Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 91.11% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc bought 19,626 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 41,166 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.97M, up from 21,540 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gyroscope Capital Management Group Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $893.03B market cap company. The stock increased 0.73% or $1.27   $176. About 16.81M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Fred Alger Management Inc decreased its stake in Intercontinental Exchange Inc (ICE) by 3.01% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Fred Alger Management Inc sold 118,145 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.21% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 3.81M shares of the investment bankers and brokers and service company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $268.59 million, down from 3.92M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Fred Alger Management Inc who had been investing in Intercontinental Exchange Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $42.47 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.78% or $0.57   $73.11. About 1.34M shares traded. Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) has risen 20.88%   uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.33% the S&P500. 
Among 20 analysts covering Intercontinental Exchange ( NYSE:ICE ), 17 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 85% are positive. As per Friday, June 16, the company rating was maintained by Keefe Bruyette & Woods. The rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets on Monday, August 14 with “Buy”. Morgan on Tuesday, February 20. RBC Capital Markets maintained it with “Hold” rating and $6500 target in Tuesday, June 6 report. As per Tuesday, February 20, the company rating was upgraded by JP Morgan. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Thursday, May 19 by Buckingham Research. 
Fred Alger Management Inc, which manages about $21.12B and $22.15 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Baxter International Inc (NYSE:BAX) by 11,639 shares to 37,581 shares, valued at $2.43M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in International Paper Co. (NYSE:IP) by 1.41M shares in the quarter, for a total of 1.48 million shares, and has risen its stake in Boeing Co (NYSE:BA). 
Analysts await Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (NYSE:ICE) to report earnings on May, 2. They expect $0.88 EPS, up 18.92% or $0.14 from last year’s $0.74 per share. ICE’s profit will be $511.22 million for 20.77 P/E if the $0.88 EPS becomes a reality. After $0.73 actual EPS reported by Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts 20.55% EPS growth.
